name: standardsforge
description: Answer defense engineering standards questions from the installed StandardsForge database, with exact evidence and explicit gaps.

interface.shortDescription: Ask your installed standards library, without web research
interface.longDescription: Answer from installed defense engineering standards, retrieve exact edition-bound evidence, and report missing evidence without unsolicited web research. Requires an operator-configured local StandardsForge MCP connection and installed corpus. This plugin supplies workflow instructions; it does not install a runtime, download standards, grant access or disable host web tools.
defaultPrompt: Use $standardsforge:standardsforge with only my installed database; no web. Cite editions and readable source pages.
